title: ActionRequest
description: A request from cognition for the action layer to do something in the world.

id.description: Unique request id (uuid4 hex). The matching AuditRecord echoes it.

intent.description: Verb-noun label, e.g. run_code, send_actone, move_arm.

args.description: Intent-specific arguments. Open unless a per-intent validator is registered.

sandboxed.description: Must this run inside vera_sov's sandbox? Executor refuses to run a false here without an override.

reversible.description: Can the effect be undone? Irreversible actions require a passing verifier before execution.
